title: Make Microsoft AutoUpdate answer msupdate in unattended runs
notes: 2026-11-23: msupdate --list exits 0 with 'XPC Connection to updater invalidated' on every run, so the plugin skips before --install. HowToCheck is now AutomaticDownload, so MAU still updates on its own when it runs.
Smallest next step: check whether launching the MAU agent (open -g -j the Microsoft AutoUpdate app or its LaunchAgent) before msupdate makes the XPC call answer, without opening a window.
